Title: Public Cloud Operations Lead
Industry: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, Book and Periodical Publishing, and Telecommunications
Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
The Public Cloud Operations Lead is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for supporting and leading Public Cloud operations and Site Reliability Engineering (CloudSRE).
  
  
This is not a coordination-only role. The successful candidate is expected to remain actively involved in cloud troubleshooting, incident investigation, automation, observability, and technical problem solving while providing day-to-day technical leadership to the CloudSRE team and oversight of managed service providers.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a minimum of 4 years of relevant cloud, SRE, or infrastructure operations experience, previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent, and strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS. Experience with GCP and OCI is considered an asset.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Technical Leadership
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical leadership to the CloudSRE team, remaining actively engaged in engineering, operational activities, and complex troubleshooting.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for cloud infrastructure, reliability, performance, availability, and major operational issues, leading root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Establish engineering standards and technical guardrails while mentoring engineers and strengthening the overall technical capability of the CloudSRE team.

Public Cloud Operations
  
  

* Provide hands-on administration, operations, and troubleshooting across Microsoft Azure and AWS, with experience in GCP and/or OCI considered an asset.
* Work across cloud technologies including networking, compute, storage, identity, RBAC/IAM, PaaS services, security, monitoring, backup/recovery, and high availability.
* Drive improvements in reliability, security, performance, operational efficiency, and cost, while supporting incident, problem, change, capacity, and availability management.

SRE & Observability
  
  

* Drive proactive monitoring and observability across infrastructure, platform, and application services using logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and service-health telemetry.
* Apply SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, availability, capacity, incident, and problem management to improve service reliability and operational maturity.
* Improve alert quality, reduce noise, and use operational telemetry to proactively identify reliability, performance, capacity, and service-health risks, leveraging platforms such as Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or equivalent.

Automation & Engineering
  
  

* Identify repetitive operational activities and automate them to reduce manual effort, operational risk, and human error using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Leverage Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Promote an engineering-first approach to cloud operations, driving continuous improvement through automation, standardization, and reusable engineering solutions.

AI & AIOps
  
  

* Drive the practical adoption of AI-assisted operations and AIOps within the CloudSRE team, incorporating AI into day-to-day operational and engineering workflows.
* Apply AI-assisted capabilities to troubleshooting, incident investigation, log analysis, operational analysis, automation, and documentation to accelerate problem resolution.
* Identify and implement opportunities where AI agents, AI-assisted engineering tools, and AIOps platforms can reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enhance service reliability.

Incident & Problem Management
  
  

* Provide technical leadership during high-severity Public Cloud incidents, coordinating troubleshooting across CloudSRE, application teams, Cyber, infrastructure teams, vendors, and cloud service providers.
* Drive effective root-cause analysis and corrective/preventative actions, identifying recurring incidents and implementing engineering, automation, or monitoring solutions to prevent recurrence.
* Improve MTTD and MTTR through better observability, automation, runbooks, operational practices, and proactive problem management.

Vendor Management
  
  

* Provide technical oversight and direction to managed service providers and technology vendors, while maintaining internal technical ownership and accountability.
* Review vendor performance including technical deliverables, incident response, SLA adherence, engineering quality, and compliance with established cloud operational standards.
* Identify and address vendor capability or performance gaps, challenging technical solutions where appropriate and driving vendors toward sustainable engineering solutions and corrective actions.

Collaboration & Communication
  
  

* Collaborate closely with application teams, infrastructure, Cyber, engineering, service management, vendors, and cloud service providers to deliver reliable Public Cloud services.
* Translate complex technical issues into clear, actionable information for technical, non-technical, and leadership stakeholders, including risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Provide clear technical direction and coordination during incidents, operational activities, and cross-functional initiatives.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Public Cloud engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, infrastructure operations, DevOps, or a related technical discipline.
* Previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, SRE Lead, Cloud Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role.
* Strong hands-on Microsoft Azure experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience.
* Strong cloud troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience with cloud networking, compute, storage, IAM/RBAC, monitoring, security, backup/recovery, and PaaS technologies.
* Demonstrated experience with observability and monitoring technologies and practices.
* Experience with automation and scripting, such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and/or DevOps automation.
* Experience with JIRA/Conflence
* Experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience leading or participating in high-severity incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
* Experience providing technical direction or oversight to third-party vendors or managed service providers.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GCP and/or OCI.
* Experience with Dynatrace or comparable enterprise observability platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container platforms such as AKS, EKS, or GKE.
* Experience implementing SRE practices such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and service-health metrics.
* Experience with AI-assisted operations, AIOps, AI agents, or AI-enabled troubleshooting and automation.
* Relevant Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, or SRE certifications are considered an asset.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The successful Public Cloud Operations Lead will
* Be a technical leader who remains hands-on, rather than operating solely as a coordinator or people manager.
* Be capable of independently troubleshooting complex Azure and AWS issues.
* Provide clear technical leadership during critical incidents.
* Improve reliability through better observability, automation, and SRE practices.
* Reduce manual operational effort through engineering and automation.
* Help the team adopt AI and AIOps as practical tools for day-to-day CloudSRE operations.
* Raise the technical capability of the broader CloudSRE team through mentoring and technical leadership.
* Hold vendors accountable for both service delivery and technical quality.
* Continually identify opportunities to improve the reliability, security, performance, efficiency, and cost effectiveness of Public Cloud services.

Title: Principal Program Manager, Data Center Infrastructure Equipment (LLE/OFCI)
Description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO&I) is the team behind the cloud. Within CO&I, the Engineering Procurement & Construction (EPC) organization is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.

This role supports Data Center Equipment Financial Planning & Strategy owns financial planning for the Americas Region, budgeting and business-case work for Owner-Furnished, Contractor-Installed (OFCI) and Long-Lead Equipment (LLE) across hyperscale data center programs in the Americas. The role builds and manages OFCI/LLE capital budgets, tracks operating expenses (OPEX) and equipment storage costs, and turns spend data into clear insights that guide equipment strategy and investment decisions.

The position works closely with Sourcing & Procurement, Engineering, Category Management, Construction, Capacity Planning and Finance to forecast equipment demand, track spend against plan, and build business cases for equipment strategies such as pre-buys, storage, modularization and supplier capacity. This role keeps spend under control, flags financial risks early and supports on-time, cost-effective delivery of critical infrastructure equipment to data center sites.

This role is eligible for remote or hybrid work of 3 days minimum per week if located within 50 miles of a hub location; Redmond, WA, Atlanta, GA, San Antonio, TX, Phoenix, AZ, or Washington DC.

 **Responsibilities**

**Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Build, manage and forecast OFCI/LLE capital budgets across Americas programs, in line with capacity plans and project schedules.
* Own the OPEX budget for equipment programs, tracking actual spend against plan and explaining variances to leadership.
* Run monthly and quarterly forecasts, accruals and reconciliations with Finance.

**Storage Cost Management**

* Budget and track equipment storage costs, including warehousing, logistics, insurance and handling.
* Watch storage use and how long equipment sits in storage, and reduce costs and unnecessary inventory.
* Work with Logistics and Site teams to match storage strategy to delivery schedules and IST dates.

**Business Cases & Equipment Strategy**

* Build data-driven business cases for pre-buys, capacity reservations, modularization, skidding and storage strategies.
* Model total cost of ownership, cost avoidance and schedule-risk tradeoffs to support leadership decisions with Regional Cost teams.
* Help Sourcing and Category Management assess supplier proposals, pricing structures and commercial options.

**Reporting & Executive Insights**

* Deliver dashboards and executive reports on OFCI/LLE spend, budget health, storage, savings and cost avoidance.
* Turn financial data into clear recommendations for GSC leadership and executive reviews.
* Flag financial risks early and drive plans to reduce them with partner teams.

**Systems, Tools & Data**

* Own the team's financial planning tools, reporting and data, with one shared source of truth for equipment financial data.
* Keep budget, forecast, PO, storage and spend data accurate and consistent across ERP/SAP, Procore, procurement systems and Finance records.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and standard templates, and set data standards and naming conventions.
* Use automation and AI-enabled workflows (Power Automate, Copilot) to cut manual work and improve forecast accuracy.
* Gather system needs and work with Finance, IT/Digital and Global Supply Chain tooling teams on improvements and integrations.

**Process, Governance & Team Enablement**

* Standardize budgeting, tracking and business-case processes across the region.
* Make sure work follows Microsoft finance policies, approval thresholds and audit requirements.
* Train the team on tools, models and reporting, and keep playbooks and SOPs up to date.
* Review processes and controls regularly so they scale with the growing data center portfolio.

 **Qualifications**

Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.

3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.

8+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

1+ year(s) of experience reading and/or writing code (e.g., sample documentation, product demos).

Title: Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead

Description:

WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.
  
  
The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.
  
  
You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

* Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance
* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.
* GIS & Digital Twin Integration
* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS) with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational Digital Twin environments (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.
* 3D Visualization & Reality Capture
* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of Reality Capture datasets (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.
* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

Title: Senior Incident Responder
Description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Incident Responder to lead the investigation of and response to cybersecurity incidents across our internal environment and our Managed Security Services (MSSP) customers.

The role is responsible for acting as the senior escalation point for the 24x7 SOC and leading incidents from detection through containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned. The Senior Incident Responder will strengthen incident response readiness, digital forensics and playbooks, and will turn every incident into better detections and controls. The role requires deep technical expertise, calm judgment under pressure, and strong communication with customers, executives and technical teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the incident response strategy and maturity roadmap aligned with SOC and MSSP business objectives.
* Align incident response processes with frameworks such as NIST SP 800-61, ISO/IEC 27035 and MITRE ATT&CK.
* Define incident response metrics, such as time to contain and time to recover, and drive their improvement.
* Recommend improvements to incident response tooling and automation, including SOAR playbooks and AI-assisted triage.
* Feed lessons learned into detection, hardening and cyber resilience improvements.
* Lead investigations of escalated and major incidents across endpoints, networks, cloud and identity platforms.
* Perform digital forensics (disk, memory, log and cloud), malware triage and root-cause analysis.
* Direct containment, eradication and recovery actions with technical teams and customers.
* Conduct intelligence-led threat hunting to find attacker activity and scope compromises.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, runbooks and forensic procedures.
* Work with Detection Engineering and Threat Intelligence to turn findings into detections and advisories.
* Act as the senior escalation point for SOC analysts and manage the incident lifecycle within SLAs.
* Take part in the on-call rotation to ensure 24x7 coverage for critical incidents.
* Coordinate incident communications with customers, vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain evidence handling and chain-of-custody standards.
* Run post-incident reviews and produce incident reports with root cause and corrective actions.
* Plan and run tabletop exercises, and maintain incident response readiness (tools, access and contacts).
* Support regulatory, contractual and audit requirements, including incident notification.
* Mentor and coach SOC analysts in investigation and response techniques.
* Deliver training and maintain the incident response knowledge base.
* Promote a culture of accountability, calm execution and continuous improvement.
* Foster collaboration between SOC, engineering, infrastructure and customer-facing teams.
* Brief customers and executives during and after major incidents.
* Participate in customer service reviews, and support incident response retainer and service offerings.
* Support pre-sales discussions on incident response capabilities.
* Provide executive-level reporting on incidents, trends and improvement actions.
* Contribute to the growth and enhancement of MSSP incident response services.

**Qualifications and Job Specific skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of cybersecurity experience with at least 5 years in incident response or digital forensics roles.
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR, GNFA or ECIH preferred.
* Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR, SIEM, SOAR and forensic tools (e.g., Velociraptor, KAPE, Volatility).
* Experience responding to incidents in enterprise, cloud (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365) and multi-tenant MSSP environments.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, ransomware operations and threat actor behavior.
* Excellent communication and decision-making skills under pressure.
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR, GNFA or ECIH preferred.

Title: Network Operations Senior Advisor (Network Operations)
Description:
Job Posting Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Position Objective:**

The Senior Advisor serves as the principal strategic and technical sounding board to the VP of Network Operations. Orchestrating operational excellence across all network domains and drive the transition from a complex legacy infrastructure to a future-state, zero-touch architecture – targeting TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) maturity and a modernized, unified NOC.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

* Act as the primary trusted advisor to the VP of Network Operations on long-term strategy, operational risk management, and technology lifecycle investments.
* Evaluate and translate emerging technological trends (e.g., 6G readiness, advanced edge computing, network slicing) into actionable, high-yield operational roadmaps.
* Advise on the governance of operational frameworks across the entirety of the operator’s footprint to ensure alignment with global standards and corporate KPIs.
* Provide strategic direction and operational efficiency oversight across eight core domains:
* Mobile Network: Next-gen RAN, vRAN, OpenRAN, and multi-generation (4G/5G/5G-Advanced) core alignment.
* Fixed Network: FTTx, GPON, and next-generation fixed access operations.
* Transport Network: IP/MPLS, Optical (DWDM), Segment Routing, and microwave backhaul optimization.
* Core & Cloud Network: Cloud-native network functions (CNFs/VNFs), telco cloud infrastructure (OpenStack, Kubernetes), and hybrid-cloud operational paradigms.
* IT Operations: Alignment of corporate IT infrastructure, workplace tech, and data center operations with network functions.
* Cybersecurity: Embedding DevSecOps into network operations, ensuring infrastructure resilience, threat mitigation, and strict regulatory compliance.
* OSS/BSS: Transforming legacy Operations and Business Support Systems into agile, microservices-driven architectures.
* AIOps Strategy Formulation: Define the overarching AI/ML roadmap for Network Operations to move toward predictive, generative, and closed-loop autonomous operations.
* AIOps Implementation: Drive the deployment of Artificial Intelligence for AI Operations (AIOps) platforms to ingest vast streams of telemetry data across Fixed, Mobile, and Cloud networks for real-time anomaly detection and predictive scaling.
* Generative AI & LLMs in Ops: Evaluate and pilot Generative AI applications (such as LLM-powered network assistants) to accelerate Tier-1/Tier-2 engineering troubleshooting, synthesize complex RCA (Root Cause Analysis) logs, and automate routine configuration scripts safely.
* Data Governance for Networks: Collaborate with Chief Data Officers/IT to establish robust data pipelines, ensuring clean, structured, and real-time network telemetry data is available to train and mature AI models.
* AI Governance & Explainability: Ensure AI/ML and closed-loop automation decisions remain auditable and explainable (XAI), preserving engineer trust and regulatory compliance as autonomy increases.
* AI Capability Upskilling: Act as a change agent to foster an AI-first mindset across the engineering workforce, advising the VP on the talent and skills gap required to operate a cognitive network.
* Lead the transformation of the NOC from siloed, domain-specific monitoring into a unified command center, consolidating EMS/NMS, service assurance, and orchestration tooling across Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, Cloud, and IT domains.
* Define and continuously optimize the NOC’s tiered support structure (Tier 0 automated remediation through Tier 3 specialist escalation), shifting resolution through automation, runbooks, and AI-assisted diagnostics.
* Drive AI/ML-based event correlation, event de-duplication, and noise reduction, ensuring NOC engineers focus exclusively on actionable, service-impacting events.
* Own the end-to-end Major Incident Management process, including rapid triage, cross-domain war-room coordination, executive communication, and post-incident root-cause and problem management.
* Ensure 24/7 operational resilience through effective staffing model, shift patterns, and escalation matrices that sustain continuous, around-the-clock network assurance aligned with contractual SLA commitments.
* NOC-SOC Integration: Partner with the Cybersecurity function to align NOC monitoring and incident-response workflows with Security Operations Center (SOC) processes, ensuring unified visibility into service-impacting and security-impacting events.
* Progress the NOC toward TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) — highly autonomous, closed-loop operations — with measurable maturity targets across priority domains.
* ANL Level 4 Transition: Architect and drive the migration from manual/reactive troubleshooting to Autonomous Advanced Operations Model Level 4 (Intent-driven, highly autonomous closed-loop operations).
* Zero-Touch Self-Healing: Recommend, design, and champion AI/ML-driven initiatives to achieve predictive maintenance, automated anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis (RCA) to enable a self-healing infrastructure.
* OPEX Optimization: Identify structural inefficiencies across domains and execute modernization programs that significantly reduce operational costs while boosting Network Quality of Experience (QoE).
* Energy & Sustainability Optimization: Drive AI-based optimization of RAN and site power usage to cut energy cost, reduce emissions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Align all operational transformation workflows, information models, and open APIs with TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) - including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Framework to enable vendor-agnostic interoperability and support zero-touch, AI-ready operations.
* Enforce and mature the FCAPS (Fault, Configuration, Accounting, Performance, Security) model through modern, automated tooling.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or a strictly related technical field is required.
* A Master’s Degree (M.Sc. or MBA) is highly preferred
* Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience within the Telecommunications or closely related ICT sector.
* At least 5 years in a similar executive advisory capacity, or a senior management role within a Tier-1 telecom operator.
* Documented history of leading large-scale network transformation, automation, or modernization initiatives that yielded measurable OPEX savings or reliability gains.
* Deep understanding of complex network ecosystems (Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, IT, Cyber).
* Demonstrated experience leading or transforming a large-scale, 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC), including tiered escalation models, major incident management, and modern NOC tooling (EMS/NMS, ITSM/ticketing, alarm correlation, AIOps platforms).
* Comprehensive knowledge of TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) — including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Frameworkand traditional FCAPS infrastructure management.
* Comprehensive knowledge of AI/ML applications in telecom operations (AIOps), network virtualization (NFV/SDN), and orchestration engines.
* Industry certifications and memberships (e.g., PMP, ITIL, TOGAF, CCIE, or equivalent) are considered a plus
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to distill highly technical, fragmented architectural issues into clear, risk-managed business cases for C-suite executives and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to balance immediate operational fire-fighting with the long-term vision of proactive and zero-touch autonomy.
* Strong adaptability and a drive for continual improvement.
* Experience in time management and task prioritization.
* Excellent verbal and written English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to perform under pressure without compromising quality.

Title: Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity
Description:
**DT One | Dubai | Full-time**
**About Us**
DT One operates a leading global network for mobile top-up, digital value products and rewards. Through a single API connection, we link more than 2,800 partners, including mobile operators, money transfer operators, e-wallets, super apps and retail networks, across 190 countries. Our partners can offer over 23,000 products, from airtime and data top-ups to gift cards and bill payments. We have processed more than 1.2 billion transactions and reach a potential audience of over five billion people, helping to ensure that no one is left unconnected.
  
  
Founded in 2005 and part of the Thunes group, DT One is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in Dubai, Miami, Nairobi, London and Barcelona.
  
  
For more information visit www.dtone.com
  
  
**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity who is passionate about protecting platforms that move money and value in real time, and who wants to shape how security and infrastructure are run across a fast-growing, global business. As part of the Technology leadership team, you will own the security strategy, reference architecture and roadmap for DT One, and lead the team that builds and runs our infrastructure and security controls day to day.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Our platform processes millions of transactions every month, connects thousands of partners across 190 countries and runs 24/7 on AWS. That means our infrastructure must be resilient, our identities and privileged access tightly governed, our edge protected, and our security operations able to detect and respond quickly, while meeting the expectations of payment schemes, regulators, auditors and investors in every market we operate in.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction with the senior leadership team and act as design authority for new platforms, while staying close enough to the engineering to lead major programmes yourself, such as zero-trust access, SIEM modernisation and security as code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, technically excellent security and infrastructure leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own how DT One's infrastructure is designed, secured and operated, from the network edge and cloud landing zone through to identity, endpoints and the security operations centre.
  
  

* Define and own the security strategy, reference architectures and multi-year roadmap, working with senior leadership; run security assessments and gap analyses across the business to prioritise the controls that matter most
* Act as security design authority, reviewing and approving the architecture of new products, platforms and partner integrations so that security is designed in from the start
* Own the cloud and infrastructure security posture on AWS (and any multi-cloud footprint), including landing zone design, guardrails, CSPM, CIS hardening and security Infrastructure as Code in Terraform
* Lead network and edge security, including WAF, DDoS protection, DNS, next-generation firewalls, micro-segmentation and network access control, and drive the move to zero-trust network access in place of legacy VPN
* Own identity and access management: identity architecture, SSO (SAML, OIDC), MFA and passwordless, Conditional Access, privileged access management, identity governance and automated joiner-mover-leaver processes
* Lead security operations and the SOC, including SIEM strategy and migration, log source onboarding, detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, ingestion cost optimisation, audit logging and incident response
* Run endpoint and vulnerability management across the estate, including EDR, MDM/MAM, patching, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing and remediation with engineering teams
* Lead PCI-DSS compliance and recertification, and align our controls to ISO 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls
* Lead the security workstream for audits, partner assessments, M&A and investor due diligence, and maintain clear security architecture documentation for executives, auditors and the Board
* Set governance for the safe use of AI and generative-AI services across the business, including technical controls on unapproved tools
* Own the infrastructure and security budget: build business cases for new controls and technologies, lead vendor selection and proofs of concept, and manage a multi-vendor environment
* Build, lead and develop a team across infrastructure security, IAM, security operations and SOC, including hiring, performance management and career development

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience across infrastructure, networking and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years leading security architecture, engineering or operations teams
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Experience in payments or fintech
* Proven track record of setting security strategy and reference architectures with a CISO or CTO, and acting as design authority for new platforms
* Track record of building infrastructure and security functions from the ground up, including standing up the full IT, network and security stack for a new business at pace
* Deep hands-on expertise in network and edge security (for example Cloudflare, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco), with a strong routing, switching and core network foundation
* Hands-on cloud security experience on AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including landing zones, CSPM and security Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
* Experience delivering zero-trust network access programmes (for example Zscaler ZPA) at scale
* Strong identity and privileged access experience, for example Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, PAM platforms such as One Identity Safeguard, and IGA platforms such as Saviynt
* Experience leading SOC teams and SIEM platforms (for example Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, IBM QRadar), including platform migrations and log ingestion cost optimisation
* Experience leading PCI-DSS certification and maintaining compliance through annual recertification
* Working knowledge of CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF and ISO 27001
* Experience owning budgets, running vendor selection and explaining risk and trade-offs clearly to senior business leaders, auditors and investors
* Expert-level professional certification such as CCIE, CISSP or equivalent; CEH or vendor security certifications are a plus
* Comfortable using AI-assisted engineering to deliver faster, and interested in the security of AI services
* Fluent Arabic and English, spoken and written (essential)
* Interest in the Fintech industry and market innovations

We can offer you an environment with a culture of learning and feedback. You will have real ownership of the security and infrastructure of a platform that is used 24/7 around the world and needs to be reliable, secure and massively scalable. You will work with technology teams in different countries, and our environment and packages match the ambition of the company: building world-class engineering teams.

* Serve as the senior on-site escalation leader for critical incidents, customer concerns, operational risks, staffing challenges, service delivery issues, and infrastructure reliability matters.
  

  

Critical Infrastructure Management

  

  
* Oversee the operation, maintenance, testing, and performance of critical infrastructure systems, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, electrical distribution, cooling systems, HVAC equipment, fire/life safety systems, building controls, and associated support systems.
  
* Ensure all infrastructure is operated in accordance with approved maintenance standards, OEM guidance, risk management practices, customer requirements, and company procedures.
  
* Review system health, operating trends, asset performance, incident history, and site risk profiles to identify opportunities for reliability improvement and failure prevention.
  
* Ensure compliance with approved Methods of Procedure (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), change management requirements, and maintenance practices.
  
* Support major maintenance events, repairs, outages, commissioning activities, integrated systems testing, turnover activities, and operational readiness reviews.
  
* Lead or support root cause analysis, corrective action planning, incident response, and post-event reviews for critical infrastructure events.
  

  

Client Relationship Ownership and Service Delivery

  

  
* Serve as the Key Account Lead and primary executive owner of the client relationship, accountable for account governance, service delivery, customer satisfaction, and long-term account health.
  
* Set the tone for the contract relationship by establishing trust, clear expectations, and disciplined communication with client leadership from the start of the engagement and sustaining them throughout.
  
* Maintain a visible on-site presence and regular face-to-face engagement with client executives, site leadership, and stakeholders, and partner with them and internal stakeholders to align operations with contractual requirements, service-level expectations, business objectives, and long-term account success.
  
* Lead operational reviews, performance updates, business reviews, risk discussions, and service improvement planning with customers and leadership teams.
  
* Ensure operational delivery is aligned with contractual obligations, company standards, client expectations, and high-availability requirements.
  
* Own contract performance, including SLA and KPI attainment, scope and change management, renewals, and account growth opportunities, in partnership with legal, finance, and company leadership.
  
* Represent the company as its senior on-site executive during customer meetings, executive briefings, site visits, audits, incident reviews, and business development support activities.
  

  

Financial Management and Business Performance

  

  
* Develop, manage, and monitor operating budgets across assigned sites, accounts, or regions, including labor, materials, maintenance, subcontracted services, vendor spend, training, tools, and operational support costs.
  
* Review and analyze financial performance, operating expenses, labor utilization, cost trends, budget variances, and resource allocation to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  
* Support forecasting, annual planning, headcount planning, capital planning, financial reporting, and business case development.
  
* Ensure sound financial stewardship and alignment of operational spending with approved budgets, service requirements, and business objectives.
  
* Prepare and present operating, financial, staffing, risk, and performance updates to senior leadership and clients as required.
  
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency without compromising safety, uptime, compliance, or service quality.
  

  

Team Leadership and Organizational Development

  

  
* Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing operations leaders, managers, engineers, technicians, and support personnel.
  
* Build strong leadership teams capable of managing complex mission-critical environments with professionalism, accountability, and technical discipline.
  
* Conduct and oversee performance management activities, including coaching, evaluations, development planning, succession planning, and corrective action when necessary.
  
* Promote a culture of safety, reliability, ownership, accountability, teamwork, technical excellence, and customer service.
  
* Ensure employees are properly trained, qualified, equipped, and supported to perform their duties safely and effectively.
  
* Lead workforce planning and organizational development to support current operations, future growth, new site transitions, and client requirements.
  

  

Compliance, Safety, Risk, and Quality

  

  
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety programs, customer requirements, regulatory standards, site procedures, and applicable laws.
  
* Promote and reinforce a strong safety culture across all operations, maintenance, vendor, and project activities.
  
* Lead or support audits, inspections, operational assessments, quality reviews, customer reviews, and compliance evaluations.
  
* Identify operational, technical, financial, staffing, safety, and compliance risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  
* Ensure documentation, maintenance records, operational reports, training records, procedures, incident reports, and compliance materials are maintained at a high standard.
  
* Support business continuity planning, emergency preparedness, escalation procedures, and operational risk reviews.
  

  

Vendor and Contract Management

  

  
* Provide senior oversight of vendor relationships, contracted services, maintenance providers, OEM support, and third-party service delivery.
  
* Ensure vendors meet performance expectations, safety requirements, contractual obligations, response times, documentation standards, and customer requirements.
  
* Partner with procurement, legal, finance, and account leadership to support vendor selection, contract execution, scope development, cost control, and service performance.
  
* Review vendor performance, maintenance quality, incident support, staffing levels, and service gaps to ensure operational reliability.
  
* Support the development of vendor escalation plans, emergency response coverage, preventive maintenance schedules, and critical spares strategies.
  

  

Transition, Startup, and Operational Readiness

  

  
* Lead or support new site transitions, account startups, operational mobilizations, client onboarding, and handover from construction or commissioning to operations.
  
* Ensure staffing, training, vendor support, procedures, CMMS readiness, asset data, maintenance programs, safety programs, and reporting structures are established prior to operational readiness.
  
* Partner with transition teams, project managers, commissioning teams, clients, and internal stakeholders to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and readiness requirements.
  
* Support operational readiness reviews, turnover planning, site acceptance, transition governance, and stabilization efforts.
  
* Drive structured handover processes that ensure the operations team is prepared to safely and effectively assume responsibility for the site.
  

  

Qualifications

  

Experience

  

  
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical facilities, facility management, engineering operations, or related technical environments.
  
* Minimum of 5 years in a senior management or director-level role leading mission-critical operations teams, with demonstrated experience leading a large data center portfolio and/or large, complex client accounts.
  
* Demonstrated experience managing 24x7x365 operations in high-availability environments.
  
* Strong experience with critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, cooling systems, HVAC, electrical distribution, and building support systems.
  
* Proven experience with budget management, financial oversight, forecasting, labor planning, vendor management, and operational reporting.
  
* Proven client-facing leadership as the senior owner of a client relationship, with responsibility for relationship management, service delivery, operational reviews, contract performance, and issue resolution.
  
* Demonstrated ability to build executive-level client relationships and to set the tone for a contract relationship, including through contract start-up and during critical incidents.
  
* Experience supporting AI clients and high-density, hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, or cloud data center operations preferred.
  
* Experience leading transitions, site startups, commissioning turnover, operational readiness, or account mobilization preferred.
  

  

Education

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, facilities management, construction management, business administration, or a related field preferred.
  
* Equivalent combination of education, technical training, military experience, trade experience, and relevant data center operations leadership experience may be considered.
  
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, CFM, FMP, CDCP, CDCS, Six Sigma, OSHA, electrical/mechanical trade certifications, or similar credentials are preferred.
  

  

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  

  
* Strong knowledge of mission-critical mechanical, electrical, cooling, controls, and life safety infrastructure.
  
* Strong leadership, decision-making, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  
* Ability to lead through complex operational challenges, customer expectations, staffing constraints, technical risks, and high-pressure incidents.
  
* Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, variance analysis, and resource planning.
  
* Ability to interpret technical, operational, contractual, and financial information and translate it into practical action.
  
* Strong understanding of MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, change management, preventive maintenance, incident management, RCA, and operational risk controls.
  
* Strong client relationship management skills and executive presence, with the ability to communicate effectively with executives, customers, vendors, and technical teams.
  
* Working knowledge of data center service contracts, service-level agreements, and commercial terms, and the ability to manage performance against them.
  
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across fast-paced, high-accountability environments.
  
* Strong organizational, project coordination, and governance skills.
  
* Proficiency with standard business software, reporting tools, CMMS platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.

Additional Requirements

Title: Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.
* Develop, implement and audit local standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to be in compliance with Digital Realty’s standards and industry best practices.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors and customers.
* Manage all maintenance and repair contracts to ensure compliance with maintenance standards and operational requirements. Confirm all vendors are qualified and adhere to Digital Realty’s performance standards and scopes of work.
* Responsible for timely execution of data center services such as remote hands, customer installations and service requests.
* Supervise security personnel and manage security systems including the adherence to security policies and compliance programs (as required by the Property Manager)
* Act as primary technical and operational contact for data center customers – both as the technical lead and local point of escalation during emergency events and day to day operations. Develop knowledge of customer’s core business and the business function of the customer’s local datacenter operation.
* Manage technical and operational incidents at the property, including the implementation of emergency response procedures, resource coordination, customer communication, root-cause analysis and post event remediation.
* Identify trends and analyze risks to articulate implications and impact to data center operations. Track operational metrics and other data to provide Senior Management oversight and control for both snapshot data and long-term trend analysis.
* Identify process based improvements that generate operational and financial efficiencies including the development and presentation of the business case.
* Support Property Manager with the management of expenses and assist all budgeting, forecasting and reporting requirements by providing capital and expense requirements and justifications.
* Support pre-sales process, including, but not limited to, conducting sales tours and reviewing lease proposals and lease agreements to confirm compliance with Digital Realty standards and local requirements.
* Support various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, SSAE16, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc. as may be required by Digital Realty.
* Maintain compliance with local health & safety (i.e. OSHA) standards and national electrical and building codes.

**What you’ll need**

* 10 years related facility management experience in data center operations (or related electrical or mechanical engineering field) with minimum of 5 years’ experience managing or leading data center operations teams in a large scale mission critical environment. Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering preferred.
* Solid and proven experience in the construction, commissioning, acceptance and operation of mission critical systems, including state-of-the-art electrical distribution systems, static and rotary UPS, emergency standby generation, fire alarm/suppression and monitoring systems
* Extensive knowledge of structured cabling systems, networking and connectivity standards, and hardware installation requirements.
* Proficient experience in colocation operations, including the installation and deployment of cage, rack and cable infrastructure, as well as, power circuit installation and power monitoring.
* Experience working with and deploying telecom and network providers, specifically in Meet Me Room and POP room environments
* Experience managing a change control environment
* Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning skills, with demonstrated ability to determine event root causes, performance shortfalls and required corrective actions.
* Knowledge of industry data center standards, policies & methodologies
* Knowledge of performance management & critical awareness methods and implementation standards
* Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and detail oriented
* Experience managing own budget and analyzing expenses
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook and familiarity with Microsoft Project, Visio or AutoCad
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), and power metering system

**A bit about us**

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

  

**Operations**

Our Operations team keeps our customers’ infrastructure running safely and securely. We get plenty of opportunities to take on a variety of tasks and develop our technical skills. From overseeing electrical power to cooling and fire suppression systems, our team plays a vital role in making sure everything in our data centers operates as it should.

  

**What we can offer you**

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

  

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

  

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

  

**Health and Safety**

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

  

**Our Compensation Philosophy**

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Network Build
Description:
**Brief Description**
Senior Program Manager, Network Build
  
  
**HELP CONNECT ARIZONA. BUILD THE FUTURE OF BROADBAND**
.
  
  
At Wecom Fiber, we're helping bridge the digital divide across Arizona by building and maintaining the communications infrastructure that powers homes, businesses, schools, and communities. As our next Senior Manager of Field Operations Support, you'll play a key leadership role in scaling operations, improving performance, and helping shape the future of a rapidly growing telecommunications organization.
  
  
**WHY WECOM?**
At Wecom, we believe exceptional people deserve more than a paycheck.
  
  
We're building a workplace where employees can grow their careers, make an impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications across Arizona. Our employees are helping connect communities, expand broadband access, and bring meaningful technology infrastructure to underserved areas throughout the state.
  
  
**Department:**
Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Reports to:**
Senior Director of Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Location:**
Arizona – Statewide (Field/Hybrid)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Program Manager, Network Build leads the delivery of fiber network construction across one or more markets and the Design Areas within them. This role owns the plan for each market from an accepted design package through an operational network, and is accountable for keeping every Design Area moving through the same sixteen milestones, from package accepted to operational. The Senior Program Manager sets the standard for how the Network Build Program Managers plan, report and escalate, and is the primary voice of the build program to senior leaders. The role also helps build and refine the processes the team runs on, so that planning, handoffs, reporting and vendor payment become more consistent and more efficient as the program grows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Plan and schedule ownership**

* Own the schedule and plan logic for assigned markets, including dependencies, crew capacity, quantities, production rates and weather effects, and keep them accurate as work moves from Project Controls to the Network Build team.
* Maintain the sixteen-milestone plan for every Design Area, and decide when a milestone is complete using evidence from the responsible team rather than assumption.
* Re-forecast dates when crew counts, weather, permits or materials change, and explain the effect on the market finish date.

**Milestone management and handoffs**

* Confirm the Operational state of each Design Area. The Senior Program Manager and the Network Build Program Managers confirm it; no other team does.
* Manage the release of each project to construction, including the handoff to Supply Chain for materials staging and the notice to Sales and Marketing.
* In Prescott, run the pre-construction approval sequence: Construction completes the utility locates and reports to the Program Manager, the Program Manager schedules the pre-construction walks, Design and Engineering makes comments and corrections, the City approves, and Construction is then released.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Coordinate Design and Engineering, the Permit Specialist, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center so that each handoff is clean and dated.
* Hold a weekly meeting with each team on Thursday or Friday, collect final updates by Monday, and prepare the reports for the Wednesday 30-60-90 day review.
* Escalate risks, delays and decisions early, with a recommendation and the effect on schedule and cost.

**Vendor and financial oversight**

* Make sure construction vendors are paid accurately and on time by reviewing each submitted invoice against the approved design prints before it is entered for payment.
* Track budget against forecast for each Design Area and flag variances to leadership.

**Reporting and governance**

* Report status using four labels: On Track, At-Risk, Off-Track and Complete.
* Track grant-funded markets against their commitments and prepare the reporting those programs require.
* Review the plan data for accuracy each week, and correct gaps before reports are issued.
* Communicate directly with executives and senior leaders in writing and in meetings, presenting status, risks, decisions and recommendations in plain language with the conclusion first.

**Team leadership**

* Coach and review the work of the Network Build Program Managers, set consistent reporting standards, and step in on the most complex or at-risk markets.

**Process development and improvement**

* Help design and document the processes the Network Build team follows, including milestone definitions, handoffs between teams, schedule updates, reporting and vendor invoice review.
* Review how the processes work in practice each quarter, identify recurring delays, rework and gaps, and recommend and lead improvements.
* Turn lessons from completed Design Areas into updated standards, templates and checklists that every Network Build Program Manager uses.
* Work with Design and Engineering, Permitting, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center to agree on process changes before they are adopted.
* Train and coach the Network Build Program Managers on new and revised processes, and confirm that they are followed.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least eight years of program or project management experience, including at least five years delivering outside plant fiber, utility or telecommunications construction.
* Demonstrated ability to manage schedules with dependencies, crew capacity and weather, and to explain a forecast change in plain language.
* Experience managing construction vendors, including invoice review against design documents.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting executive-level status reports, briefings and recommendations that are clear, accurate and concise.

**Preferred**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience with federal or state broadband grant programs.
* Experience with permitting for rights-of-way, railroad, highway and utility pole attachments.
* Experience leading or mentoring other program managers.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Every Design Area in the assigned markets shows an accurate, current date for each milestone.
* Forecast dates move when crews, weather or permits change, and leaders hear about the change before the weekly review.
* Vendor invoices are verified against the design prints and paid without rework.
* Handoffs between teams happen on the planned date, with no team waiting for another.
* Processes are documented, current and followed, and improvements that came from completed Design Areas are visible in the team's standards and templates.

**The Benefits Of Joining Our Team**
**Career Growth & Leadership Opportunity**

* Influence operational strategy
* Build scalable systems and processes
* Lead transformational initiatives
* Partner with executive leadership
* Support expansion into new markets
* Shape the future of construction management at Wecom

**Comprehensive Benefits & Total Rewards**
**Health & Well-Being**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage
* Supplemental Benefit Options
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Employee Assistance Resources
* Gym Reimbursement up to $600 annually

**Time Away from Work**

* Paid Weekly
* PTO Accrual Begins Immediately with No Waiting Period
* 13 Company-Paid Holidays Annually

**Financial Wellness**

* 401(k) with Company Match up to 5%

**Additional Perks**

* Cell Phone Reimbursement up to $50 per month
* Annual Boot Reimbursement up to $150 (field positions)
* Ongoing Leadership Training

**TEAM-ORIENTED CULTURE**
We've built a culture where employees are respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. We value collaboration, accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, professional growth, and recognition.
  
  
**BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER**
Join Wecom and help build the infrastructure connecting Arizona's communities today and for generations to come.

Wecom does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, religion, color, national origin, marital status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, veteran status, pregnancy status or other status protected by law.

Title: Senior Manager – IT Enterprise & Cloud Platforms
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director, Information Technology Infrastructure & Services Delivery
  
  
**Business Unit / Function:**
Pr ocurement & Business Support
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Lead infrastructure technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering across Maaden sites. Translate approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. Enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while keeping day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership with the accountable teams.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.
  
  
**Contract Strategy and Governance**
Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Recommend designs and exceptions through established architecture authorities; enterprise policy and strategy remain with the accountable leaders .
  
  
**Contract Administration and Compliance**
Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery on scope, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, architecture and standards compliance, acceptance, and transition to operations. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery, including support documentation and knowledge transfer. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.
  
  
**Contractor Performance Management**
Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery

Title: Technical Program Manager, Network
Description:
**About Cape**
Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.
  
  
Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected
*and*
have privacy.
  
  
We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.
  
  
Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.
  
  
**The Team**
At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.
  
  
**The Role:**
Cape's network team designs how traffic actually moves through our infrastructure: routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and the vendor-implemented changes that make it all work. Right now, that work is coordinated ad hoc, and the team needs someone to take real ownership of task tracking, timeline accountability, and communication across engineering, business development, and vendors. This role is the first of its kind in the network team. We're looking for a Program Manager who is technical enough to challenge engineering estimates, sanity-check what BD is promising customers, and set delivery timelines the team can actually hit.
  
  
You'll work in close partnership with the network operations lead to roadmap upcoming work, surface dependencies and conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep vendors accountable to what they've committed to. Telco or network experience is a plus, but we care more about startup instincts and a bias toward realistic, forward-moving plans than about a background in telecom specifically.
  
  
**What You'll Work On:**

* Own Jira hygiene and task tracking for the network team, bringing structure to work that is currently coordinated informally
* Build a reliable system for tracking work, exposing dependencies, and catching timeline slips early, across network engineering, BD, and vendors
* Partner closely with the network team's technical lead to roadmap infrastructure work like routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and cloud/vendor integrations
* Pressure-test proposed timelines and BD requests for technical feasibility before commitments are made externally
* Host vendor meetings and hold vendors accountable to their delivery commitments
* Deconflict priorities and dependencies across the network team and adjacent teams, including consumer-facing projects
* Translate technical network work for non-technical stakeholders, and translate business requests back into realistic technical asks for engineering
* Help define the org model for how program management, technical ownership, and execution responsibilities fit together on the network team as it scales

**Experience:**

* Technical program management experience in a fast-moving engineering environment, ideally at a startup
* A track record of bringing structure to ambiguous, cross-team work without slowing it down
* Comfort learning a new technical domain quickly and deeply enough to challenge engineering judgment and assess feasibility, not just track progress
* Experience building systems for tracking work, surfacing dependencies, and holding owners accountable to deadlines
* Strong communication skills; able to translate between technical teams and business/vendor stakeholders
* Comfort engaging directly with external vendors and holding them to their commitments
* (Bonus) Experience with network or telco infrastructure: traffic routing, cloud connectivity, configuration, or subscriber provisioning
* (Bonus) Experience at a company building or operating physical/network infrastructure rather than pure software
* (Bonus) Prior experience supporting consumer products alongside more technical/infrastructure work

**Compensation:**
We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role based in New York, NY is $190,00 - $210,000 depending on level, experience, and interview performance.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* 401(k) match
* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents
* 12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)
* Stipends for
* Family-forming needs
* Gender-affirming care
* Unlimited PTO

**Our Culture & Values**

* We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.

Description:

**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries.
