Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Atos is seeking a
**Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations**
to lead the North American client delivery organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this executive will be accountable for the operational performance, service delivery execution, customer experience, and financial health of a large, multi-practice delivery organization supporting more than
**$1 billion in annual business**
and a workforce of more than
**1,000 delivery professionals**
.
  
  
This leader will oversee a broad and complex portfolio that includes managed infrastructure services, compute, data center, network, cloud, cybersecurity, applications, digital workplace, application management services, staff augmentation, project-based delivery, and long-term managed services. The role requires a leader who understands the operational and commercial differences between time-and-materials engagements, project delivery, and managed services, and who can establish a consistent delivery model across them.
  
  
The Senior Director will serve as the delivery organization’s primary service provider to Atos account and client leadership teams. While this individual will not directly own customer accounts, they will be accountable for ensuring that the services promised to customers are delivered effectively, consistently, and profitably. The role will work closely with account teams, practice leaders, and business-line executives to align delivery capabilities with customer requirements and business commitments.
  
  
This leader will establish common operating practices, strengthen collaboration across business lines, clarify ownership, and modernize delivery through automation, artificial intelligence, and innovative operating models.
  
  
Success will require significant experience leading large-scale technology delivery organizations, strong commercial and financial acumen, executive presence, and the ability to drive accountability across a complex matrixed environment. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading through organizational change and operational uncertainty, stabilizing customers in crisis, challenging legacy approaches, and making difficult decisions while maintaining the trust of customers, employees, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Enterprise Client Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Own overall service delivery execution across the North American client delivery organization.
* Provide leadership across an organization of more than 1,000 delivery professionals supporting a business portfolio exceeding $1 billion annually.
* Ensure consistent achievement of contractual commitments, service-level agreements, operational targets, customer outcomes, quality standards, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear accountability for delivery performance across practices, business lines, and service portfolios.
* Create a culture of operational excellence, customer focus, transparency, urgency, and disciplined execution.
* Partner with practice leaders and account teams to identify and mitigate delivery risks before they affect customers.
* Serve as the senior executive escalation point for significant delivery, service, operational, and customer issues.
* Lead the stabilization and recovery of complex or distressed customer engagements, including situations involving service disruption, performance deterioration, delivery breakdowns, or customer dissatisfaction.
* Ensure delivery leaders maintain effective operational governance across both long-term customers and new or transitioning engagements.

Shared Delivery and Service Integration
  
  

* Lead an integrated delivery model encompassing staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services.
* Align delivery across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Ensure customers experience one coordinated Atos delivery organization, regardless of the technologies, business lines, or delivery teams involved.
* Establish standardized operating procedures governing service transitions, work transfers, escalations, ownership boundaries, resource deployment, and cross-practice collaboration.
* Eliminate operational silos and reduce delays, ownership confusion, inconsistent practices, and failed handoffs between service areas.
* Define clear roles and decision rights among practice operations, account leadership, client management, solution teams, and delivery organizations.
* Resolve organizational friction, competing priorities, and operational conflicts that impede customer delivery.
* Preserve the technical expertise of individual practices while aligning them around common customer and business outcomes.

Financial and Business Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and operational performance of the North American client delivery organization.
* Drive improvements in margin, productivity, utilization, scalability, delivery quality, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with practice leaders, account leaders, finance, workforce management, and portfolio owners to optimize staffing, capacity, location strategy, and workforce planning.
* Maintain an effective balance between customer commitments, service quality, employee capacity, and profitability.
* Identify structural cost, productivity, and delivery-model improvements that strengthen the performance of the existing book of business.
* Support revenue retention and growth by increasing customer confidence, improving service consistency, and strengthening delivery credibility.
* Establish performance metrics, operating reviews, executive dashboards, and corrective-action mechanisms that provide transparency across the organization.
* Hold leaders accountable for operational commitments, financial performance, risk mitigation, and sustainable improvement.

Customer Experience and Service Excellence
  
  

* Ensure delivery decisions are driven by customer impact rather than internal organizational boundaries.
* Improve customer satisfaction, service quality, responsiveness, reliability, and delivery consistency.
* Partner with account and client leadership teams to understand customer priorities and translate them into executable delivery plans.
* Provide delivery expertise and operational support to account teams without displacing their commercial ownership of the customer relationship.
* Improve the organization’s ability to anticipate customer concerns and resolve issues before they become executive escalations.
* Build strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders during critical delivery situations, service recoveries, and major transformations.
* Reinforce accountability for the entire customer outcome rather than individual service towers, practices, or contractual components.
* Use customer feedback, operational data, service trends, and root-cause analysis to drive measurable improvements.

Transformation, Automation, and AI
  
  

* Develop and execute a transformation roadmap for the North American delivery organization.
* Modernize legacy processes, governance structures, and delivery practices to improve speed, consistency, and accountability.
* Advance the use of AI, automation, analytics, and intelligent operations across service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, accelerate issue resolution, improve service predictability, and enhance the customer experience.
* Establish scalable operating models that support multiple service types, technologies, and customer environments.
* Promote greater use of standardized tools, processes, controls, and performance data.
* Lead the organization through a period of significant change while maintaining service continuity and customer confidence.
* Position the delivery organization to operate successfully in an increasingly AI-enabled technology services market.

Organizational and Practice Leadership
  
  

* Provide leadership and direction to practice and delivery leaders responsible for specialized service portfolios.
* Build a cohesive leadership team aligned around shared customer, operational, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Develop succession plans and strengthen the organization’s delivery, operational, and customer-leadership capabilities.
* Create an environment that rewards collaboration, transparency, responsible decision-making, and enterprise-wide thinking.
* Challenge internal behaviors and legacy structures that prioritize practice interests over customer outcomes.
* Communicate a clear transformation vision and translate that vision into measurable operating priorities.
* Bring energy, resilience, and visible leadership to a large organization navigating substantial operational and market change.

**Required Qualifications**

* Approximately 15 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, client delivery, operations, managed services, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading a large, complex delivery organization, preferably involving more than 1,000 employees or delivery professionals.
* Significant experience overseeing an annual business portfolio, delivery organization, or P&L approaching or exceeding $1 billion.
* Experience operating across multiple technology domains, such as managed infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Proven understanding of staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services operating models.
* A successful record of leading service transformation, organizational integration, operating-model redesign, or enterprise delivery modernization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer escalations, distressed engagements, operational crises, and service-recovery programs.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with margin improvement, utilization, workforce planning, productivity, cost management, and P&L performance.
* Experience leading through a matrixed organization in which delivery, practices, account teams, sales, finance, and customer leadership have interconnected responsibilities.
* Ability to understand a broad technology services portfolio sufficiently to make sound operational decisions and lead specialized practice executives.
* Executive-level communication, stakeholder-management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.
* Willingness to challenge established practices, address performance issues, and make difficult decisions when customer or business outcomes are at risk.
* Demonstrated judgment, self-awareness, resilience, and leadership maturity.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.

Leadership Profile
  
  
The successful candidate will be
  
  

* Customer-centered Consistently prioritizes customer outcomes over internal structures and organizational boundaries.
* Operationally rigorous Establishes clear standards, measures performance, and maintains consistent accountability.
* Transformational Challenges legacy approaches and converts a broad modernization vision into executable change.
* Crisis-tested Remains composed and decisive during major customer, service, and organizational challenges.
* Commercially grounded Understands how delivery quality, cost, customer confidence, and profitability affect one another.
* Enterprise-minded Leads across the entire delivery organization rather than advocating for a single practice or technology tower.
* Influential Aligns senior stakeholders and specialized leaders without relying solely on organizational authority.
* Energetic and resilient Brings visible momentum to a large organization operating through significant change.
* Self-aware Understands their impact on others, listens to competing perspectives, and adjusts appropriately without compromising accountability.
* Decisive Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and accepts responsibility for outcomes.

Location and Travel
  
  
This position may be based anywhere in the United States, with the Irving, Texas area preferred. The role is expected to require occasional travel of up to approximately 25 percent
  
  
The base compensation range for this role is $250,000 – $300,000 USD.

* Help create the next piece of work by spotting follow-on needs, shaping proposals, developing client-specific points of view and contributing actively to account plans and pursuits.
* Bring A&M specialists and external experts into the work when needed, and make sure the client receives one integrated answer rather than a collection of separate work products.
* Own project quality, scope, schedule, team performance and engagement economics. Coach Managers and junior team members and contribute to the continued development of the P&U practice.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related field. An MBA or equivalent postgraduate business qualification is a plus, not a requirement.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in Power & Utilities, infrastructure, energy or water, data center (digital infrastructure), cooling and waste with meaningful project, advisory or operating exposure in the Middle East and/or Africa.
* Depth in at least one core P&U area, together with enough breadth to work across adjacent parts of the utility value chain.
* Experience gained in consulting, advisory, a utility or developer, EPC and capital projects, infrastructure investment, or a relevant government or regulatory organization.
* Evidence of leading multidisciplinary teams, working through incomplete information and turning analysis into practical client actions.
* Commercial awareness and growing business-development capability, including proposal development, client relationship management and negotiation.

Title: Senior Customer Delivery Manager
Description:
**About the role**

As a Senior Customer Delivery Manager, you will be accountable for leading the delivery of contracted Run Services for a large customer account or a portfolio of smaller accounts.

You will lead and manage teams of people, both directly and through matrix management. You’ll implement and operate an effective governance model to ensure that the services are delivered to satisfy both the Customer’s and Computacenter’s required outcomes, including but not limited to service levels, customer satisfaction and financial targets. You’ll also play a key role in the account leadership team working together to grow Computacenter’s business with the Customer.

You’ll have a role to play as a coach and mentor to other employees to ensure the continuous development of Computacenter and its people, not just as a Line Manager within your own team. You’ll also have a responsibility to engage and play a part as a senior manager in the wider organisation, working within strategic change and ongoing transformational initiatives in our Group Delivery business.

**What you’ll be doing**

* You'll be a part of the Delivery Leadership team, either in your own right or reporting through the Delivery Lead/Senior Delivery Lead to our customers.
* You'll have clear areas of accountability and will be given appropriate autonomy to lead the areas of the service that you are responsible for.
* You'll also form part of a wider community of Delivery Lead’s and will have the opportunity to actively contribute to wider in-country Delivery initiatives.

Delivery Leadership

* Lead and manage the delivery of run and change services to deliver what we’ve promised our customer and our own organization.
* Constantly drive us to do better for our customer and our own organization.
* Objectively manage performance of our internal and partner delivery teams.
* Be able to demonstrate understanding of our performance, what it means to our customer’s business, and what we’re doing to improve.
* Look to continually improve both the efficiency & effectiveness of delivery processes and services, adding value that is relevant to the customer throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Identify risks in service delivery, assess commercial implications and take measures to eliminate risk or avoid risk.

Change Delivery Management

* It’s likely that you’ll have a role leading change for our customers. Sometimes this will be relatively simple in-life service change, sometimes in supporting out Group Services colleagues it will be pulling the Computacenter organization together to deliver more complex change. In carrying out these duties, you will demonstrate awareness of relevant project management approaches.
* You’ll use your contacts and insight to identify new ways in which Computacenter can add value to our customers.

Business Leadership

* Work with the Senior Delivery Manager/Delivery Director as well as Group Services and other colleagues, as appropriate, to support the account strategy and to ensure that Computacenter presents itself as a single, joined-up team to the customer.
* Contribute to and deliver against a communications plan, both customer-facing & internal, ensuring clear & consistent messaging both verbally & in written form across various media.

Contract Management

* Support Group Services in the development, negotiation, and agreement of contract changes within the Customer account.
* Support the management of the contract schedules that relate to your scope of service. You’ll ensure compliance and manage exceptions.

Financial Management

* Manage the finances of your account or assigned services to ensure accurate forecasting and cost management to achieve or exceed financial baselines.

Relationship Management

* Work with the Delivery Lead/Snr Lead and account team to define and support the engagement strategy with the customer and other stakeholders.
* Primary interface to one or more senior stakeholders within the customer organization ensuring that you maintain a positive and constructive relationship to the benefit of both organizations.

**What you have**

* Legally eligible to work in the United States.
* You’ll be an experienced practitioner in IT Service Management.
* You’re likely trained in ITIL, possibly to Expert status.
* You’ll know that it’s not all about ITIL. You’ll be able to show that you understand how IT services fit in a customers’ business and how we as a service provider can add value.
* Perform all Line Management responsibilities for all Direct Reports. Ensure that your team, direct and virtual, is appropriately motivated and engaged and that individual performance is managed.
* Support the people strategy for the account, including capacity and succession planning, people and capability development and talent identification and retention.
* Support the communications strategy in support of the account and employee engagement strategies.
* Use coaching skills to lead and develop Services and other people within the customer account.

**What you can expect**

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

**About us**

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta. www.computacenter.com/us

*This job posting is for an existing vacancy*
**We’re looking for our next Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering**
We are searching for a Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering to guide, mentor, and scale the engineering squad responsible for our platform stability. At Questrade, we don’t just watch dashboards, we build the intelligence that anticipates failures. Our mission is to achieve absolute reliability and resilience, ensuring our high-frequency trading platforms remain unshakable under the pressure of global markets.
  
  
In this role, you will lead a team of talented SREs who don't just fix problems in Production, they engineer out their possibilities. You are a player-coach and an evangelist for Site/System Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles who views manual toil as a bug to be automated. Most importantly, you will set the technical vision for how your team leverages Machine Learning (ML) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform reactive operations into predictive, self-healing systems.
  
  
**The mandate**
**Your Domain: Leading at the Intersection of SRE & AI**
As The Team Lead, System Reliability Engineering Within The Questrade Experience Platform Engineering Group, You Will Balance Hands-on Architectural Leadership With People Management. Your Playground Involves
  
  

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, coach, and grow a squad of System Reliability Engineers. Conduct 1:1s, drive career development, foster a culture of psychological safety and high accountability, and manage capacity across sprint work and on-call rotations.
* SRE Strategy & Governance: Champion SRE best practices across the engineering organization. Guide your team and partner squads in defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets to balance the velocity of innovation with the necessity of stability.
* AI-Powered Operational Vision: Spearhead the roadmap for applying ML models to "Smart Alerting" and anomaly detection, guiding your team to move beyond static thresholds toward systems that understand patterns and mitigate outages before they happen.
* Autonomous Resilience: Oversee the architecture and implementation of self-healing workflows. Whether it's auto-scaling GKE clusters or building LLM-assisted incident response playbooks, you are steering the development of the "autopilot" for our production environments.
* Cloud Native Excellence: Set the architectural standard for orchestrating highly available systems using GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform, and Helm, ensuring our infrastructure is declarative, versioned, and resilient.
* Executive Incident Command: Serve as an escalation point and Principal Incident Commander during critical, high-severity incidents. Lead cross-functional "War Rooms" with Engineering, DBAs, Network teams, and Executive stakeholders, and champion a blameless post-mortem culture to drive long-term system improvement.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of trading systems is desired but not required.

**You’re ready for this mandate if you have the following qualifications**
You are a high-level problem solver and inspiring technical leader who bridges the gap between deep systems knowledge, software engineering, and people management.
  
  
**Leadership & Strategic Execution**

* Proven Team Leadership: 7+ years of experience in System Reliability or DevOps engineering, including 2+ years in a formal Team Lead, Tech Lead, or Engineering Management capacity mentoring and managing engineers.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to align engineering squads, product owners, and executive leadership around reliability roadmaps, error budgets, and architectural investments.
* Blameless Culture Builder: You foster an environment where engineers feel safe to experiment, own mistakes, and learn rapidly through rigorous, blameless post-mortems.

**Your Technical Arsenal**

* Automating Support: Strong software engineering background with mastery of Python, C#, and Bash to guide code reviews and build scalable automation frameworks.
* Cloud & Orchestration: Mastery of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE); advanced proficiency in container orchestration and IaC using Kubernetes (kubectl), Helm, and Terraform.
* Modern Observability: Advanced capability in Splunk (Administration/Querying) and Datadog, with experience architecting AI-enhanced observability and dashboards.
* System Versatility: Strong experience with Linux systems and a solid understanding of Windows IIS server, enabling you to guide troubleshooting across a diverse application stack.
* Database & Network Mastery: Strong grasp of MS SQL/MySQL and a deep understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, UDP).

**Mastery of the Incident Lifecycle**

* Incident Command & Escalation: Act as the senior lead during high-severity events, coordinating between Engineering, DBA, Network, and Executive stakeholders to drive rapid service restoration and clear communication.
* The "Resolution First" Mindset: You possess the technical intuition to quickly distinguish between symptoms and root causes under pressure, guiding your team in applying immediate remediation followed by systemic fixes to eliminate technical debt.
* Automated Incident Response: You champion the use of Python, Bash, and AI-driven tools to automate common remediation patterns (e.g., auto-restarting stalled pods, triggering failovers, or clearing cache bottlenecks).
* Predictive Analysis: Lead initiatives using AI and smart alerting to identify "near-misses"—anomalies that didn't cause an outage this time, but will if left unaddressed.

**The SRE Mindset**

* Toil’s Worst Enemy: You relentlessly protect your team's engineering bandwidth by prioritizing the automation of repetitive operational tasks.
* AI Champion: You actively explore and advocate for how Generative AI can summarize logs, accelerate root cause analyses, and elevate internal documentation.
* Resilient Under Pressure: You model calm, decisive leadership in high-pressure trading environments, including managing team on-call rotations and market-critical batch windows.

**Why You’ll Thrive at Questrade**

* Leading the Fintech Frontier: Work at the center of Canada's most innovative brokerage, where your team's reliability directly protects and empowers the financial future of our clients.
* A Culture of Ownership: You aren't a cog; you are a decision-maker. We empower you to shape team strategy, propose architectural shifts, and lead high-impact technical investments.
* Infinite Learning: We don't just support your growth—we demand it. From AI workshops and leadership development to advanced cloud certifications, you and your team will be constantly evolving.

***Enter your career inflection point. Apply now.***

Effective written and verbal communication skills are key, with strong critical-thinking abilities, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as a team. **Work Location:** This is a remote position with core working hours of 8am – 5pm EST

* Lead the coordination and management of impacting incidents to ensure timely service restoration while minimizing disruption to customers and business operations.
* Execute the enterprise Incident Management process, including monitoring incident queues, prioritizing incidents, and coordinating escalations to drive timely resolution.

* Becoming a trusted advisor to the customer.

* Seen as a resource to the team in one or more technical or business areas.
* Becoming a trusted advisor inside and outside the team/technology area.

* Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
* Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of experience, a Master's Degree and 3 years of experience, an Associate's Degree and 7 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years of experience

Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, operational risks, and execution priorities effectively to engineering teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Strong understanding of end-to-end network configuration, technical dependencies, production service behavior, and operational best practices.

Title: Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security
Description:
**Why We Are - Who We Are:** About FFF Enterprises
  
What We Do - https://www.fffenterprises.com/company/what-we-do.html
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Vice President, Infrastructure Services & Information Security leads the strategy, engineering, delivery, and operation of enterprise infrastructure services and information security across FFF Enterprises and its affiliated businesses. The position is accountable for the reliability, scalability, resilience, and security of technology platforms and services, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, networks and communications, digital workplace and end-user services, distribution center technology, cybersecurity operations, and enterprise information protection.
  
The role establishes and executes integrated infrastructure and information security roadmaps, operating standards, service ownership models, security controls, and continuous improvement priorities aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business requirements, and regulatory obligations. Responsibilities include technology service delivery, operational resilience, information security governance, cyber risk management, vulnerability and third-party security oversight, incident preparedness and response, and secure adoption of emerging technologies.
  
Through leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams and collaboration with business and technology stakeholders, the Vice President strengthens service reliability, security effectiveness, operational performance, and organizational capabilities. The position provides informed recommendations to executive leadership regarding technology investments, material risks, operational priorities, and performance outcomes while supporting established escalation, risk acceptance, and independent assurance processes.
  
  
Essential Functions and Duties
  
Enterprise Technology & Security Strategy, Governance & Roadmaps:
  

* Lead integrated infrastructure services and information security planning, establishing multi-year roadmaps aligned with enterprise technology strategy, business growth, critical service needs, and applicable security requirements.
* Define organizational design, service ownership, roles, decision rights, and escalation practices across infrastructure engineering, operations, cybersecurity, security governance, and supporting vendors.
* Establish common planning and review cadences for service performance, security posture, investment decisions, remediation priorities, material incidents, and continuous improvement.
* Advise executive leadership on technology modernization, emerging threats, resilience, automation, AI, and the balance among service quality, security, risk, and cost.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering:**  

* Lead cloud and platform services across Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, operating systems, compute, storage, backup integration, identity integration, infrastructure as code, and cloud financial management.
* Establish platform engineering standards that strengthen availability, scalability, security hardening, configuration consistency, automation, and lifecycle management.
* Oversee platform modernization, technical debt reduction, capacity planning, patching coordination, and cloud consumption governance while maintaining secure architecture and change controls.
* Ensure infrastructure configurations, privileged access, logging, and recovery capabilities support applicable security and operational requirements.

**Network & Communications:**  

* Direct enterprise and distribution center network services, including WAN, wireless, cloud connectivity, internet redundancy, DNS/DHCP, VPN, voice, and collaboration systems.
* Establish network architecture, segmentation, resilience, capacity, monitoring, and lifecycle standards for reliable and secure connectivity.
* Define engineering ownership, operational escalation, and security responsibilities for network access, perimeter protections, and business-critical network services.

**Digital Workplace, End User Services & IT Service Management:**  

* Lead digital workplace and employee technology services for office, remote, hybrid, and distribution center personnel, including endpoint engineering, mobile management, Microsoft 365, collaboration, provisioning, patching, and device lifecycle.
* Oversee service desk operations and IT service management practices across incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, and service catalog management.
* Govern endpoint security integration, asset inventory, administrative controls, secure configuration, licensing, vendor services, and secure device disposition.
* Establish measurable employee service outcomes, service levels, ownership, and continuous improvement practices across supported environments.

Site Reliability, Operational Resilience & Business Continuity:
  

* Lead monitoring and observability, service reliability engineering, incident management, root-cause analysis, backup validation, capacity management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness for critical business services.
* Establish recovery objectives, resilient designs, redundancy requirements, continuity exercises, and recovery testing aligned with critical business processes and security scenarios.
* Direct coordinated operational response to major technology availability incidents, including service restoration, escalation, stakeholder communications, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Coordinate infrastructure recovery and business continuity capabilities with information security incident response planning, including ransomware resilience and recovery testing.

**Warehouse & Distribution Center Technology Enablement:**  

* Oversee distribution center technology enablement, including warehouse wireless services, RF devices, scanners, printers, shipping workstations, local infrastructure, and site support.
* Coordinate technology dependencies for warehouse control systems, automation and conveyor interfaces, PLC connectivity, site upgrades, and peak-period readiness with Operations and vendors.
* Establish support boundaries, cybersecurity coordination, availability expectations, and escalation pathways for operational technology and warehouse infrastructure.
* Ensure appropriate business-critical recovery, segmentation, resilience, monitoring, and security controls for distribution center technology.

**Information Security Program, Architecture & Operations:**  

* Direct the enterprise information security program across FFF and applicable affiliated businesses, safeguarding confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and technology assets.
* Develop and maintain security strategy, policies, technical standards, control baselines, information classification, and security architecture aligned to enterprise operating requirements.
* Oversee security monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, endpoint and network protection, identity and privileged access security, security configuration, and remediation governance.
* Establish enterprise processes for identifying and evaluating cyber threats, reviewing emerging technologies, and embedding security into technology architecture, product development, procurement, and change management.
* Guide security capabilities and qualified internal or external specialists to provide risk-informed protection of platforms, applications, networks, sensitive information, and technology services.
* Develop security awareness and role-based training programs, promoting informed, accountable security behaviors among employees, contractors, and approved users.

**Cyber Risk, Information Protection & Third-Party Assurance:**  

* Establish and maintain the enterprise information security risk assessment process, including threat evaluation, control assessment, risk treatment tracking, and documentation of material exposures.
* Oversee cybersecurity reviews of technology suppliers and material third parties, including contractual security requirements, assessment findings, remediation commitments, and ongoing risk monitoring.
* Coordinate with business owners, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Audit on information ownership, data classification, secure handling, retention, and protection requirements.
* Report material cybersecurity risks, control deficiencies, third-party exposures, exceptions, and remediation status to designated leadership and risk governance stakeholders.
* Establish clear processes for identifying, assessing, documenting, escalating, and monitoring information security risks, ensuring material risk acceptance and independent assurance activities remain subject to established enterprise governance and designated approval authority.

**Security Policy, Regulatory Compliance & Audit:**  

* Lead development, maintenance, implementation, and communication of practical enterprise information security policies, standards, and procedures.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Internal Audit to evaluate applicable obligations and control expectations, including HIPAA, PCI DSS, CCPA/CPRA, and other relevant requirements as determined by the business.
* Coordinate security control assessments, audit evidence, remediation plans, and management responses in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit, while respecting their independent responsibilities.
* Use risk-based frameworks such as NIST and ISO 27001, where appropriate, to inform security maturity assessments, control effectiveness measures, and improvement roadmaps.
* Track security policy exceptions, audit findings, control deficiencies, and overdue remediation, and communicate material developments through established governance channels.

**Cybersecurity Incident Response & Crisis Coordination:**  

* Direct and coordinate preparedness, detection, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned during material information security incidents.
* Convene and coordinate designated security incident response resources and business stakeholders, with clear authority, severity classifications, playbooks, escalation triggers, and communication processes.
* Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, executive leadership, and external specialists on notification assessments, law enforcement engagement, evidence preservation, and crisis communications, as applicable.
* Oversee incident response exercises, technical readiness, external incident response retainers, and improvement activities following security events.
* Escalate material cybersecurity incidents promptly and coordinate technical recovery with operational continuity and established legal and crisis management processes.

**Infrastructure Architecture, Automation & Responsible AI:**  

* Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference designs, engineering practices, lifecycle planning, interoperability, and secure target-state direction.
* Advance infrastructure automation, orchestration, reusable platforms, self-service capabilities, and responsible AI-assisted operational tools with appropriate controls and human oversight.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and AI governance stakeholders to assess information protection, system access, reliability, and operational risks before new technology adoption.
* Prioritize emerging technology investments based on measurable service improvement, security outcomes, business value, operational complexity, and cost.

**Financial, Vendor & Performance Management:**  

* Own approved infrastructure and information security operating budgets, financial plans, contracts, vendor performance, resource allocations, and delivery commitments within established financial authority.
* Develop business cases and investment recommendations addressing resilience, modernization, technical debt, security maturity, regulatory exposure, and risk reduction.
* Establish integrated service and security measures for reliability, incident response, recovery, vulnerability remediation, control effectiveness, audit progress, service quality, customer experience, and cost.
* Provide regular reporting to executive leadership on service performance, material risk, financial results, investment progress, incident trends, vendor outcomes, and roadmap commitments.
* Maintain effective vendor governance for technical service levels, security obligations, incident response support, contractual performance, and required corrective actions.

**Organization, Workforce & Talent Leadership:**  

* Build and develop a high-performing combined Infrastructure Services and Information Security organization with clear functional leadership, accountability, technical expertise, and appropriate segregation of duties.
* Lead multi-year workforce and capability planning, succession, critical-role coverage, insourcing and outsourcing decisions, vendor augmentation, and targeted capability development.
* Develop leaders, managers, engineers, and security practitioners through coaching, performance management, cross-training, knowledge transfer, and career development.
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence, service ownership, proactive risk identification, ethical decision-making, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
  
  
**Required Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.

**Preferred Education:**  

* Advanced degree in technology leadership, cybersecurity, business administration, or related discipline.

**Required Knowledge:**  

* Enterprise infrastructure architecture and operations across public and private cloud, networking, endpoints, collaboration, identity services, and IT service management.
* Information security governance, cyber risk assessment, security architecture, threat and vulnerability management, identity and access security, incident response, and third-party assurance.
* High-availability engineering, observability, disaster recovery, business continuity, and secure technology lifecycle management.
* Recognized security and risk frameworks, security control assessment, and applicable privacy and compliance considerations, including HIPAA and other relevant regulations.
* Budgeting, vendor governance, service metrics, security performance reporting, and enterprise technology investment planning.

**Preferred Knowledge:**  

* Azure, Google Cloud, Nutanix, Microsoft 365, Intune, Jamf, RingCentral, Terraform, or comparable technology ecosystems.
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and security architecture or risk governance practices.
* Distribution center wireless, warehouse automation, operational technology, and high-availability transaction environments.
* Responsible AI-assisted operations, security monitoring automation, modern identity security, and cloud security practices.
* Pharmaceutical distribution, specialty healthcare services, or other regulated and business-critical operating environments.

**Required Experience:**  

* Minimum of fifteen (15) years of progressive information technology experience, including at least seven (7) years in senior technology leadership.
* Demonstrated senior-level leadership across enterprise infrastructure services and information security, including accountability for multidisciplinary technical teams, operational performance, cyber risk management, and enterprise technology initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience directing cloud, network, digital workplace, service operations, resilience, and cyber risk or information security programs in complex, distributed organizations.
* Experience directing or overseeing security incident response, risk assessments, control remediation, security assessments, and communication of material risks to executive leadership.
* Experience building and executing multi-year roadmaps, managing budgets and vendors, developing organizational capabilities, and delivering measurable technology and risk outcomes.

**Preferred Experience:**  

* Experience holding a CISO, head of information security, or comparable enterprise security leadership mandate.
* Leadership of technology services for distribution centers or other high-availability and regulated operations.
* Experience with hybrid cloud, SRE, modern service management, vulnerability management, and security operations maturity programs.
* Experience coordinating incident response with executive leadership, Legal, Compliance, auditors, regulators, insurers, or external response specialists as needed.
* Experience integrating infrastructure and information security functions while preserving appropriate risk escalation, independent assurance, and governance.

**Required Skills:**  

* Senior-level technology leadership with the ability to integrate infrastructure reliability, cybersecurity effectiveness, operational resilience, and disciplined resource management.
* Sound judgment during significant service and security incidents, clear escalation, crisis coordination, and concise communication to executive leadership and technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to establish organizational accountability, service ownership, effective decision rights, and appropriate segregation of duties across engineering and security functions.
* Analytical leadership using service and security measures, risk assessments, root-cause analysis, business cases, and performance reviews to inform decisions.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, vendor management, negotiation, strategic planning, change leadership, and talent development skills.

**Preferred Skills:**  

* Applying security engineering and responsible AI capabilities to improve operational resilience, service quality, and control effectiveness.
* Communicating complex security exposures, incident consequences, and technology investments in business and risk terms.
* Leading integrated organization design and security program modernization within a multi-entity enterprise.

**Required Professional Certification:**  

* None required.

**Preferred Professional Certification:**  

* Relevant credentials such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, ITIL 4, Azure or Google Cloud certifications, TOGAF, PMP, or comparable infrastructure and cybersecurity qualifications.

Physical requirements

Must have the ability to view a computer screen for prolonged periods and the ability to sit for extended periods. Must have the ability to work the hours and days required to complete the essential functions of the position, as scheduled. Must have the ability to lift and maneuver items of at least 20 lbs. Title: Global Security Operations Centre Manager
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

**International SOS is currently looking to hire a Global Security Operations Centre Manager in Doha, Qatar.**

The GSOC Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the GSOC, including but not limited to provision of guidance and supervision to other GSOC members such as GSOC Supervisor and GSOC Operator, in line with the direction set by QatarEnergy and in accordance with global standards, processes and industry best practices.

The GSOC Manager will work closely with the GSOC Supervisor and the GSOC Operator, to ensure operational planning and request management guidance are done in lockstep with ongoing and continuous intelligence assessments.

The GSOC Manager will act as enabler in the process of decision-making, in both business-as-usual and crisis scenarios, and provide required insights to support the analytical position and outlook of QatarEnergy.

The GSOC Manager will closely collaborate with the GSOC team (Supervisor and Operator) in one hand, and other departments of QatarEnergy on another, ensuring the relevant throughputs of GSOC contain an appropriate security risk assessment as part of any response and plan of action. In principle, the GSOC Manager will provide Quality Assurance check on the output of GSOC.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Core Support to QatarEnergy**

  

* Oversee GSOC operational preparedness, ensuring timely security advice and clear risk assessments are provided to QatarEnergy stakeholders and business travellers.
* Provide strategic direction and oversight of GSOC request management, operational planning and service provider networks, ensuring alignment with QatarEnergy’s security outlook.
* Oversee the quality and continuous improvement of GSOC deliverables, ensuring alignment with security risk management best practices and operational requirements.
* Develop GSOC team capabilities through guidance, coaching and training in global threat monitoring, travel risk management, and crisis and emergency management.
* Collaborate with QatarEnergy stakeholders and internal departments to ensure effective query management, operational coordination and security planning.
* Maintain and enhance travel risk management resources, including hotel and security provider information, ensuring they reflect the current security environment.
* Contribute to security capability enhancement projects, including risk management training and Concept of Operations development.
* Conduct regional travel, as required, to assess security environments, evaluate local provider capabilities and strengthen security intelligence and assistance networks.
* Participate in regional security calls and support security escalations, including Crisis Updates, Crisis Management Team (CMT) briefings, and the development and execution of Plans of Action (POAs).
* Provide guidance and oversight for Executive Protection (EP) requests, leveraging vetted providers and regional expertise.

### 

### **Global Threat Monitoring**

  

* Provide strategic oversight of global threat monitoring activities and intelligence outputs, ensuring alignment with global standards and best practices.
* Guide analytical direction, validate threat assessments and integrate intelligence insights into organisational risk management and decision-making.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Oversee the delivery of travel security risk management services, ensuring alignment with client expectations and continuous intelligence assessments.
* Ensure quality assurance of travel-related security outputs, recommendations and operational planning.
* Engage with stakeholders to support the effective implementation of travel security strategies.

### 

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

  

* Lead GSOC operations during crises and major incidents, providing strategic direction and enabling informed decision-making.
* Oversee crisis response activities and ensure effective coordination between GSOC, internal departments and external partners.
* Approve escalation decisions and ensure appropriate communication with senior leadership.
* Maintain quality assurance across incident reporting, response actions and crisis management outputs.
* Support continuous capability development through training, mentoring and improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**
-------------------------------

* Extremely strong knowledge of the security risk management best practices and principals across a diversity of risk environments.
* Experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Experience in conducting profile specific security risk assessments.
* Strong knowledge of the political and security landscape within QatarEnergy’s Region of Operation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including ability to explain complex situations and advice to non-expert audiences in English.
* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of security, logistics and threat-based information under time pressure and produce plans of action.
* Ability to identify key streams of effort and direct colleagues accordingly.
* On the ground experience in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operation.
* Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

**Required Work Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically, at least 8+ years’ experience in security assistance delivery and planning including deployed experience in hostile and/or challenging environments in military, NGO, government or private sector roles ideally in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operations.
* Experience in planning and conducting security assistance operations.
* Experience in writing to senior management and decision-makers.
* Experience in successfully working cross culturally.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Crisis management and Business Continuity Management experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery experience.
* Public speaking, client-facing presentation and/or media experience.
* Experience in business development and quality management

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Educated to a degree level (or relevant professional training & experience) in a field related to security studies, war studies, international politics, international relations or similar.
* Accreditation by regionally recognised security or risk management body.

**Required Languages**
----------------------

* Excellent spoken and written English language.
* Other language (Arabic, French, etc.) proficiency desirable.

The Network Manager position will lead and perform advanced-level network administration and operational oversight as part of the City's Network Team, supporting the daily availability, performance, and security of enterprise-wide communications infrastructure that includes WAN/LAN, data center, wireless, voice, and public safety networks. In addition, the Network Manager will guide and mentor technical staff, collaborate closely with other IT teams and City departments, and ensure networks supporting cameras, radio systems, and mission-critical applications remain highly available, secure, and compliant, while also contributing to longer-term planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives to meet the evolving needs of City services and the community
  
  
Under general supervision, the Innovation and Technology Network Manager is to plan, organize and direct information technology functions related to Networking, Data Center Operation, and Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications and to perform related work as required.
  
  

* Actual job classification is Innovation and Technology Officer II (Non-Classified). Positions designated as non-classified are exempt from the classified service. The incumbent will be appointed "at-will" and serve at the pleasure of the City Manager.

**For positions indicating a salary range from 1N – 2X, the top 15% of the pay range cannot be offered upon hire or upon an employee promotion.**
Work Performed
  
  
Typical duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Develop and implement project plans to accomplish work group objectives and assign work and monitor performance. Take action in the full range of formal personnel activities, and provide contract oversight in conjunction within the Innovation and Technology Department.
* Provide subject matter expertise in highly complex mission critical enterprise-wide systems which require expertise in multiple industry areas.
* Prepare, negotiate and present budget and other funding proposals; monitor expenditures and operate within budget allocation.
* Develop strategic plans and implement operational plans to provide information technology infrastructure to support the City's/Department's business goals; and oversee one or more of the following technical areas: Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Manager Applications, Networking, and Data Center Operations.

When assigned to Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications:
  
  

* Manage all activities related to the design, development and implementation of information systems and software applications.
* Oversee maintenance, support and upgrade of existing systems and applications.
* Confirm software integration into existing systems, meets functional requirements, systems compliance and interface specifications.
* Design, develop, and install enhancements and upgrades to systems and application software.
* Compile and maintain an inventory of all software and system assets, and corresponding contracts and agreements.
* Develop training materials for end users and conduct training as necessary.

**When Assigned To Networking**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of a complex communications infrastructure, including radio, microwave and wireless communications, voice services, including WAN/LAN technology, switches, routers and fiber optics, and supporting management applications.
* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of over 1,000 security cameras.
* Establish schedules and internal controls to meet deadlines.
* Manage city-owned or leased equipment and line and service installation and expansion.
* Identify areas for improvement and implement and maintain new or improved services to meet changing technical and customer requirements.
* Review, evaluate and recommend telecommunications hardware and software packages.

**When Assigned To Data Center Operations**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise the enterprise computing services including messaging and collaboration software including, email, unified communications, servers, desktop and server virtualization technologies, enterprise desktop management tools, data storage and backup infrastructure, Active Directory, VPN and system monitoring tools.
* Design and implement short and long-term strategic plans to ensure system capacity meets existing and future requirements.
* Ensure a high level of application, server and storage, and enterprise system availability.
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures, and associated training plans for related infrastructure operations.
* Plan the acquisition and installation of hardware equipment, applicable enterprise system software and maintenance agreements.
* Maintain data center facilities.
* Assist with the planning and deployment of server, storage infrastructure and enterprise system security measures.
* Develop, implement and maintain an efficient, well documented disaster recovery plan.

**Qualifications**
**OPTION I:**

* Education: A Master's degree in computer science, information systems or public/business administration.
* Experience: Three years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing, and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Ii**

* Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering, voice/data communications, public/business administration or a related field.
* Experience: Four years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iii**

* Education: Associate of Arts degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering voice/data communications, public/business administration or related field.
* Experience: Six years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iv**

* Education: Equivalent of the completion of the twelfth grade.
* Experience: Eight years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Necessary Special Qualifications**

* When assigned to the Police Department, must be able to successfully pass an extensive police background.

**Network Manager Highly Desirables**

* Enterprise Network Architecture and Engineering: Advanced experience designing, implementing, and managing large-scale WAN/LAN environments, including routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, fiber-optic infrastructure, wireless networking, network segmentation, SD-WAN, and enterprise connectivity.
* Network Leadership and Staff Development: Proven success managing technical teams, establishing performance expectations, delegating responsibilities, mentoring employees, addressing performance deficiencies, and maintaining accountability for operational and project outcomes.
* Project Management and Strategic Planning: Demonstrated ability to independently plan, budget, coordinate, and deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing competing priorities, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and long-term technology modernization strategies.
* Operational Excellence and Infrastructure Lifecycle Management: Extensive experience establishing and enforcing network operational standards, preventive maintenance programs, patch management, change control procedures, hardware lifecycle planning, asset management, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* Network Security, Resiliency, and Business Continuity: Strong background implementing enterprise security controls, firewalls, Zero Trust principles, secure connectivity, redundancy, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions supporting mission-critical services.
* Financial, Procurement, and Vendor Management: Proven experience developing and managing technology budgets, evaluating procurement requirements, administering vendor contracts, monitoring service-level agreements, validating deliverables, and maintaining financial accountability.
* Communication, Collaboration, and Organizational Accountability: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated success proactively communicating project status, identifying and escalating risks, maintaining follow-through, coordinating across departments, and presenting technical information to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Enterprise Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Continuous Improvement: Advanced experience managing enterprise network monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, capacity planning, network automation, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Public Safety and Mission-Critical Infrastructure: Experience managing complex networking environments supporting public safety communications, radio and microwave systems, surveillance cameras, telecommunications, fiber infrastructure, and other essential 24/7 government or enterprise services.

Title: IT Infrastructure Manager - Network, Server & Azure
Description:
We are seeking an experienced IT Operations Manager to lead the design, operation, security, and continual improvement of Daniels Health’s core technology infrastructure. This role owns the enterprise network, server and hybrid infrastructure environment, and Microsoft Azure tenant, ensuring these platforms are reliable, secure, scalable, well-governed, and aligned with business requirements across global entities.
  
  
The IT Operations Manager is accountable for the operational health and strategic evolution of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. This includes network connectivity, firewalls, wireless, servers, virtualization, storage, backup and disaster recovery, Microsoft Azure services, identity and access integrations, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure lifecycle management. The role partners closely with Cybersecurity, Service Desk, Applications/Development, and business stakeholders to provide secure, resilient technology services for field, operations, and office personnel, both remote and onsite.
  
  
This position combines people leadership, hands-on technical depth, vendor management, operational governance, and project delivery. The successful candidate will establish clear ownership, standards, documentation, performance measures, and roadmaps for the infrastructure estate.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the operational performance, availability, capacity, security, and lifecycle management of enterprise network, server, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure.
* Lead and develop infrastructure personnel, contractors, and managed service providers; establish clear priorities, expectations, accountability, technical standards, and development plans.
* Design, implement, maintain, and continually improve resilient network services, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, internet connectivity, firewalls, wireless, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and network segmentation.
* Own server and compute platforms, including Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, storage, file and print services, directory services, and supporting infrastructure components.
* Own the Microsoft Azure tenant and associated platform services, including subscriptions, resource organization, governance, networking, compute, storage, backup, monitoring, cost management, and role-based access controls.
* Manage hybrid connectivity and integrations among Azure, on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, SaaS platforms, and business applications.
* Establish and maintain infrastructure monitoring, alerting, health checks, performance baselines, capacity planning, and operational reporting.
* Ensure infrastructure changes are properly planned, reviewed, tested, documented, communicated, and implemented in accordance with change-management and security requirements.

Security, Resilience, and Compliance
  
  

* Partner with the Cybersecurity team to implement and operate secure infrastructure configurations, identity controls, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, logging, endpoint/server hardening, and privileged-access practices.
* Ensure timely patching and remediation for servers, network devices, Azure services, and supporting infrastructure, using risk-based prioritization and documented exceptions where necessary.
* Own backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery capabilities for infrastructure services; conduct and document regular restoration and failover tests.
* Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster-recovery procedures for critical infrastructure platforms.
* Maintain accurate network diagrams, infrastructure inventories, configuration standards, runbooks, recovery procedures, and technical documentation.
* Ensure infrastructure practices support applicable company security, privacy, compliance, and audit requirements.

Architecture, Projects, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop and maintain a multi-year infrastructure roadmap covering network modernization, server and virtualization lifecycle, Azure adoption, security enhancements, resilience, and technical debt reduction.
* Lead infrastructure projects from requirements through design, implementation, transition to operations, and post-implementation review.
* Evaluate infrastructure technologies, service providers, licensing models, and architecture options; recommend solutions based on business value, reliability, security, scalability, and total cost of ownership.
* Manage infrastructure vendors, carriers, cloud providers, hardware suppliers, and managed service partners; hold vendors accountable to contractual obligations and service levels.
* Drive standardization, automation, and operational maturity through infrastructure-as-code where appropriate, scripting, repeatable deployment practices, and streamlined support processes.
* Establish and report meaningful operational KPIs, including platform availability, incident trends, patch compliance, backup success, recovery testing, capacity, project delivery, service performance, and Azure spend.
* Collaborate with the Service Desk to ensure effective escalation paths, knowledge transfer, service transition, and timely resolution of infrastructure-related incidents.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, including network, server, cloud, or hybrid environments.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in an infrastructure, systems, network, cloud operations, or IT operations management capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, vendors, managed service providers, or complex infrastructure projects.
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise network services across multiple sites and remote users.
* Experience administering and governing Microsoft Azure environments in a production enterprise setting.
* Experience with server administration, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, patch management, and infrastructure lifecycle planning.
* Experience effectively communicating cross-functionally and with stakeholders at varying levels of the organization.

Technical Proficiencies
  
  

* Proven experience as an IT Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, or Operations Manager, with the ability to lead, mentor, and hold technical personnel accountable.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, wireless, WAN/SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, network segmentation, and network troubleshooting.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including tenant/subscription governance, resource groups, virtual networks, network security controls, Azure Virtual Machines, storage, backup, monitoring, policy, cost management, and role-based access control.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Entra ID integrations, Group Policy, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and recovery, and core infrastructure services.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoint management, and hybrid cloud architecture.
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring and management tools, log management, vulnerability-management processes, and reporting platforms such as Power BI and Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, and service-transition management. Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Experience managing infrastructure vendors, telecommunications providers, cloud service providers, licensing, contracts, and renewals.
* Ability to translate business requirements into secure, supportable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions.

Professional Competencies
  
  

* Ability to see the broader contribution of infrastructure services to business continuity, productivity, customer service, cybersecurity, and growth.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and lead coordinated responses to major incidents.
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, options, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Dynamic and innovative approach to problem solving, operational improvement, and technology modernization.
* Diligent in following and improving security, compliance, documentation, and change-control processes.
* Commitment to high-quality service, operational excellence, ownership, and continual improvement.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or comparable Azure certification.
* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or comparable network certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher.
* Security, cloud, virtualization, or disaster-recovery certifications relevant to the environment.

Title: Senior Project Manager, ICT
Description:
**Senior Project Manager, ICT**

**Level 5: $106,199 - $127,432**

**Vision**

The Toronto Catholic District School Board (TCDSB) is proud to be a significant part of the fabric of publicly funded Catholic education in the province of Ontario. We serve approximately 84,000 students in nearly 200 Catholic schools in the City of Toronto and represent close to 475,000 Catholic school supporters. At the TCDSB, we grow in knowledge, with justice and hope. The TCDSB is an inclusive Catholic learning community that nurtures faith development and academic excellence through the love of God, neighbor, and self.

We fully engage students in learning that supports their academic, spiritual, socio-emotional, and physical growth and development. At TCDSB, we have a long and distinguished history of providing excellence in Catholic education for the Toronto community. The Ontario Catholic School Graduate Expectations our Catholic values, and the Board's Pastoral Plans are foundational to our exemplary approach to teaching and learning in the 21st Century.

With a staff of 14,000, the TCDSB is a dynamic school board and is seeking a full-time **Senior Project Manager, ICT** within the **ICT** department.

All interested applicants are welcome to apply; we are an inclusive employer.

-

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Project and Portfolio Management, this position will have overall responsibilities to manage and monitor the IT project portfolio as well as the delivery and support of the project management office and business analysis services as well as oversee IT project management and business analysis staff. The successful candidate will work closely with ICT Division management and technical teams, support departments, internal stakeholders, and other leaders in support of organizational needs.

* Support the Senior Manager, Project and Portfolio Management with optimal adoption of the Objective & Key Result (OKR) goal setting framework used by the ICT Division for defining measurable goals and tracking their outcomes.
* Provide strategic management and leadership for the IT project portfolio management (PPM) for the project management office (PMO) and business analyst (BA) staff.
* Assist in the development and standardization of PPM, PMO and BA policies, procedures, methodologies, and tools to ensure the department delivers consistent value to the broader organization.
* Develop and supervise a team of project management and business analysis staff, directing their activities, as well as setting and monitoring team-level OKRs.
* Review and approve project intake, oversee the PPM pipeline, as well as prepare reports and deliver presentations.
* Act as the top escalation level for PPM, PM, and BA services and supports.
* Liaise with ICT Division management and teams including Student Records & Reporting, Technology Infrastructure & Applications, Technology Support, Cyber Security & Privacy.
* Interact directly with senior and executive staff on key projects and initiatives.
* Establish a comprehensive PMO resource centre that is maintained and kept current.
* Assist with RFX development and evaluation, as well as contract review and negotiation.
* Lead key and critical projects as well as provide PM support on other projects as needed P
* Perform other tasks or duties as assigned or required.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Min of four (4) years university or college degree from a recognized institution in a technology-related or business administrative field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Minimum of four (4) years of experience in enterprise technology environments managing medium to large project portfolios
* Formal training in project management frameworks such as PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) and IT service management, as well as related certifications such as PMP and ITIL
* Strong knowledge in project portfolio management including understanding of the development, implementation and maintenance of project portfolio policies, processes and procedures
* Strong leadership and management skills, ability to motivate, mentor and coach staff to coordinate, leverage and support large initiatives and operational workflows
* Broad knowledge of current and emerging project portfolio management practices as well as enterprise technologies
* Proven ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences at various levels
* Proven ability to respond competently in high-pressure and high-stress situations
* Excellent business analytical skills, ability to manage multiple priorities under strict timelines, as well as ability to work well in a demanding, dynamic environment and meet overall objectives
* Proven ability to improve client, service experience, and interactions as well as gain efficiencies
* Experience with procurement practices, contract negotiation, planning and resource management
* High level of personal integrity, ability to professionally handle confidential matters and demonstrate sound judgment.
* Experience in K-12 or higher-education technology environments would be an asset

**This is a full-time permanent position with comprehensive benefits including pension plan, vacation, and professional development opportunities.**

-

**Who We Are**

Our mission at TCDSB is to inspire learning – in every way – and support our students and employees. Employees who work in our corporate setting are passionate and have a strong belief in our mission and making TCDSB a leader in public education.

Consistent with the TCDSB’s Employment Equity policy and Multi-Year Strategic Plan, the TCDSB is strongly committed to fostering and creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the stakeholders and communities we serve.
